---
title: "Module 11: Spatial cell-type annotation with SingleR"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-12"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 11 — Spatial SingleR annotation
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Annotate the inferCNV-classified master spatial Seurat object generated
#   in Module 11 using SingleR and the celldex MouseRNAseqData reference.
#   Prepare normalized Spatial expression, identify genes shared between the
#   spatial dataset and reference, perform fine-label SingleR annotation,
#   transfer predicted identities back to Seurat metadata, compare SingleR
#   identities with inferCNV malignancy annotations, generate dimensional
#   reduction and spatial tissue maps, summarize spot composition across
#   samples, export diagnostic tables and figures, and save a stable combined
#   inferCNV + SingleR spatial Seurat checkpoint for downstream CARD and
#   CellChat analyses.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_infercnv_annotated.rds
#
# Primary output:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds
#
# SingleR prediction object:
#   data/processed/spatial/singleR/
#     spatial_singleR_predictions.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/spatial/singleR/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/spatial/singleR/
#
# SingleR settings:
#   Reference:          celldex::MouseRNAseqData
#   Annotation level:   label.fine
#   Fine tuning:        TRUE
#   Pruning:            TRUE
#   Parallelization:    SerialParam
#
# Metadata added:
#   SingleR_label
#   SingleR_pruned
#   SingleR_delta
#   predicted_spot_identity
#
# Notes:
#   - Spatial transcriptomics spots may contain multiple cells.
#   - SingleR therefore identifies the predominant reference-like expression
#     identity of each spot rather than proving that the spot contains a
#     single pure cell type.
#   - "Uncertain" denotes spots whose SingleR prediction was removed during
#     pruning.
#   - Existing Harmony-derived PCA/UMAP/t-SNE reductions from Module 07 are
#     preserved and are NOT recalculated in this module.
#   - Existing inferCNV annotations from Module 11 are retained unchanged.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(SingleR)
  library(celldex)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"

sample_column <- "sample"

cluster_column <- "spatial_cluster"

singleR_reference_label <- "label.fine"

singleR_fine_tune <- TRUE

singleR_prune <- TRUE

minimum_shared_genes <- 1000

representative_heatmap_spots <- 300

normalization_scale_factor <- 10000

sample_order <- c(
  "Normal_Tissue",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2",
  "Niacin_Treatment"
)

required_images <- c(
  "Naive_A9",
  "Vehicle1_C5",
  "Vehicle2_D5",
  "Niacin2_B5"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

singleR_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "singleR"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "singleR"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "singleR"
)

directories_to_create <- c(
  singleR_object_directory,
  results_directory,
  figure_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define input and output files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_annotated.rds"
)

final_object_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds"
)

singleR_prediction_file <- file.path(
  singleR_object_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_predictions.rds"
)

metadata_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_singleR_metadata.csv"
)

gene_overlap_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_gene_overlap.csv"
)

celltype_composition_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_celltype_composition.csv"
)

malignancy_composition_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_identity_by_malignancy_annotation.csv"
)

singleR_count_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_identity_counts.csv"
)

singleR_palette_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_color_palette.csv"
)

parameter_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_parameters.csv"
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 12 — Spatial SingleR annotation\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:      ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:         ", input_file, "\n",
  "SingleR objects:      ", singleR_object_directory, "\n",
  "Results directory:   ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:    ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "Primary output:      ", final_object_file, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate and load Module 11 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 11 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun Module 11 before Module 12."
  )
}

cat(
  "Loading inferCNV-annotated master spatial object...\n"
)

spatial_singleR <- readRDS(
  input_file
)

if (!inherits(spatial_singleR, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

available_assays <- names(
  spatial_singleR@assays
)

if (!spatial_assay %in% available_assays) {
  stop(
    "Required Spatial assay was not found.\n",
    "Available assays: ",
    paste(
      available_assays,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

required_metadata <- c(
  sample_column,
  cluster_column,
  "infercnv_input_group",
  "infercnv_score",
  "infercnv_status",
  "malignancy_annotation"
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_singleR@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "Spatial object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_singleR), "\n",
  "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_singleR), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_singleR@meta.data[[sample_column]]
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "  Images:   ",
  length(
    Seurat::Images(
      spatial_singleR
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Validate samples, images, and spot barcodes
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

observed_samples <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      spatial_singleR@meta.data[[sample_column]]
    )
  )
)

missing_samples <- setdiff(
  sample_order,
  observed_samples
)

if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Expected spatial sample(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

missing_images <- setdiff(
  required_images,
  Seurat::Images(spatial_singleR)
)

if (length(missing_images) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Expected spatial image(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_images,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_singleR)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated spatial spot barcodes were detected."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nSpots by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_singleR@meta.data[[sample_column]]
  )
)

cat(
  "\nMalignancy annotations by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_singleR@meta.data[[sample_column]],
    spatial_singleR$malignancy_annotation,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nAvailable reductions:\n"
)

print(
  Seurat::Reductions(
    spatial_singleR
  )
)

cat(
  "\nAvailable images:\n"
)

print(
  Seurat::Images(
    spatial_singleR
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Prepare Spatial assay for SingleR
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Preparing Spatial expression for SingleR\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_singleR
) <- spatial_assay

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_singleR[[spatial_assay]]
)

cat(
  "Spatial assay layers before preparation:\n"
)

print(
  spatial_layers
)

count_layers <- grep(
  pattern = "^counts",
  x = spatial_layers,
  value = TRUE
)

if (length(count_layers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No raw counts layer was found in the Spatial assay."
  )
}

if (length(count_layers) > 1) {
  cat(
    "\nMultiple Spatial count layers detected.\n",
    "Joining Spatial assay layers...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  spatial_singleR <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_singleR,
    assay = spatial_assay
  )
}

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_singleR[[spatial_assay]]
)

cat(
  "\nSpatial assay layers after joining:\n"
)

print(
  spatial_layers
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Log-normalize Spatial assay for SingleR
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Log-normalizing Spatial assay for SingleR\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_singleR <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
  object = spatial_singleR,
  assay = spatial_assay,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = normalization_scale_factor,
  verbose = FALSE
)

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_singleR[[spatial_assay]]
)

if (!"data" %in% spatial_layers) {
  stop(
    "Normalized Spatial 'data' layer was not created."
  )
}

cat(
  "Spatial LogNormalize completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Extract normalized Spatial expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_logcounts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
  object = spatial_singleR,
  assay = spatial_assay,
  layer = "data"
)

if (nrow(spatial_logcounts) == 0 ||
    ncol(spatial_logcounts) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Normalized Spatial expression matrix is empty."
  )
}

missing_spots <- setdiff(
  colnames(spatial_singleR),
  colnames(spatial_logcounts)
)

if (length(missing_spots) > 0) {
  stop(
    length(missing_spots),
    " master spatial spots are missing from the normalized matrix."
  )
}

spatial_logcounts <- spatial_logcounts[
  ,
  colnames(spatial_singleR),
  drop = FALSE
]

if (!identical(
  colnames(spatial_logcounts),
  colnames(spatial_singleR)
)) {
  stop(
    "Normalized Spatial matrix could not be aligned to Seurat spot order."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nNormalized Spatial expression:\n",
  "  Genes: ", nrow(spatial_logcounts), "\n",
  "  Spots: ", ncol(spatial_logcounts), "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Construct SingleCellExperiment
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_sce <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(
    logcounts = spatial_logcounts
  )
)

if (!identical(
  colnames(spatial_sce),
  colnames(spatial_singleR)
)) {
  stop(
    "SingleCellExperiment spot order does not match Seurat spot order."
  )
}

cat(
  "SingleCellExperiment created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Load celldex MouseRNAseqData reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Loading celldex MouseRNAseqData reference\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

mouse_reference <- celldex::MouseRNAseqData()

if (nrow(mouse_reference) == 0 ||
    ncol(mouse_reference) == 0) {
  stop(
    "MouseRNAseqData reference was empty."
  )
}

reference_metadata <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(
  mouse_reference
)

if (!singleR_reference_label %in% colnames(reference_metadata)) {
  stop(
    "Requested reference label was not found: ",
    singleR_reference_label
  )
}

cat(
  "MouseRNAseqData loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Reference genes:   ", nrow(mouse_reference), "\n",
  "  Reference samples: ", ncol(mouse_reference), "\n",
  "  Fine labels:       ",
  length(
    unique(
      mouse_reference$label.fine
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Match genes between spatial data and reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

common_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(spatial_sce),
  rownames(mouse_reference)
)

shared_gene_percent <- 100 *
  length(common_genes) /
  nrow(spatial_sce)

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Spatial-reference gene overlap\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Spatial genes:     ", nrow(spatial_sce), "\n",
  "Reference genes:   ", nrow(mouse_reference), "\n",
  "Shared genes:      ", length(common_genes), "\n",
  "Spatial overlap:   ",
  round(
    shared_gene_percent,
    2
  ),
  "%\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (length(common_genes) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No genes overlap between the spatial data and MouseRNAseqData."
  )
}

if (length(common_genes) < minimum_shared_genes) {
  warning(
    "Only ",
    length(common_genes),
    " shared genes were detected between spatial and reference datasets."
  )
}

spatial_sce_singleR <- spatial_sce[
  common_genes,
]

mouse_reference_singleR <- mouse_reference[
  common_genes,
]

gene_overlap_summary <- data.frame(
  spatial_genes = nrow(spatial_sce),
  reference_genes = nrow(mouse_reference),
  shared_genes = length(common_genes),
  spatial_overlap_percent = shared_gene_percent
)

utils::write.csv(
  gene_overlap_summary,
  gene_overlap_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Run fine-label SingleR annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "Running spatial SingleR annotation\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Reference:       MouseRNAseqData\n",
  "Label:           ", singleR_reference_label, "\n",
  "Fine tuning:     ", singleR_fine_tune, "\n",
  "Pruning:         ", singleR_prune, "\n",
  "Shared genes:    ", length(common_genes), "\n",
  "Spatial spots:   ", ncol(spatial_sce_singleR), "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

singleR_spot <- SingleR::SingleR(
  test = spatial_sce_singleR,
  ref = mouse_reference_singleR,
  labels = mouse_reference_singleR$label.fine,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref = "logcounts",
  fine.tune = singleR_fine_tune,
  prune = singleR_prune,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

if (nrow(singleR_spot) != ncol(spatial_singleR)) {
  stop(
    "SingleR prediction count does not match the number of spatial spots."
  )
}

cat(
  "Spatial SingleR annotation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Align SingleR predictions to Seurat spot barcodes
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!setequal(
  rownames(singleR_spot),
  colnames(spatial_singleR)
)) {
  stop(
    "SingleR prediction barcodes do not match Seurat spot barcodes."
  )
}

singleR_spot <- singleR_spot[
  colnames(spatial_singleR),
]

if (!identical(
  rownames(singleR_spot),
  colnames(spatial_singleR)
)) {
  stop(
    "SingleR predictions could not be reordered to Seurat spot order."
  )
}

cat(
  "SingleR prediction barcodes match Seurat spots exactly.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Add SingleR predictions to Seurat metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_singleR$SingleR_label <- as.character(
  singleR_spot$labels
)

spatial_singleR$SingleR_pruned <- as.character(
  singleR_spot$pruned.labels
)

spatial_singleR$SingleR_delta <- as.numeric(
  singleR_spot$delta.next
)

spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity <- ifelse(
  is.na(spatial_singleR$SingleR_pruned),
  "Uncertain",
  spatial_singleR$SingleR_pruned
)

cat(
  "\nPredicted predominant spatial identities:\n"
)

print(
  sort(
    table(
      spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity,
      useNA = "ifany"
    ),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
)

cat(
  "\nSingleR identity by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_singleR@meta.data[[sample_column]],
    spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nSingleR identity versus inferCNV malignancy annotation:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_singleR$malignancy_annotation,
    spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Save raw SingleR prediction object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  object = singleR_spot,
  file = singleR_prediction_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(singleR_prediction_file)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial SingleR prediction object was not saved successfully."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Save SingleR identity-count table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_identity_counts <- spatial_singleR@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    predicted_spot_identity,
    name = "spots"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      spots
    )
  )

utils::write.csv(
  singleR_identity_counts,
  singleR_count_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Generate representative SingleR score heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating representative SingleR score heatmap\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

set.seed(1234)

n_heatmap_spots <- min(
  representative_heatmap_spots,
  nrow(singleR_spot)
)

selected_spots <- sample(
  rownames(singleR_spot),
  size = n_heatmap_spots,
  replace = FALSE
)

score_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_score_heatmap_representative_spots.png"
)

grDevices::png(
  filename = score_heatmap_file,
  width = 3000,
  height = 2400,
  res = 300
)

SingleR::plotScoreHeatmap(
  singleR_spot[
    selected_spots,
  ]
)

grDevices::dev.off()

cat(
  "Representative score heatmap saved for ",
  n_heatmap_spots,
  " spatial spots.\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Create consistent SingleR color palette
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spot_identities <- sort(
  unique(
    spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity
  )
)

singleR_colors <- stats::setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(
    length(spot_identities)
  ),
  spot_identities
)

singleR_palette <- data.frame(
  predicted_spot_identity = names(singleR_colors),
  color = unname(singleR_colors),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  singleR_palette,
  singleR_palette_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Validate existing dimensional reductions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

available_reductions <- Seurat::Reductions(
  spatial_singleR
)

required_reductions <- c(
  "umap",
  "tsne"
)

missing_reductions <- setdiff(
  required_reductions,
  available_reductions
)

if (length(missing_reductions) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required upstream dimensional reduction(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_reductions,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\nRun Module 07 before Module 12."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nExisting upstream reductions retained:\n"
)

print(
  available_reductions
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Generate UMAP and t-SNE by SingleR identity
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "predicted_spot_identity",
  cols = singleR_colors,
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "UMAP — SingleR Predominant Spot Identity"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

singleR_tsne <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "tsne",
  group.by = "predicted_spot_identity",
  cols = singleR_colors,
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "t-SNE — SingleR Predominant Spot Identity"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

singleR_umap_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_UMAP.png"
)

singleR_tsne_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_tSNE.png"
)

singleR_reduction_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_UMAP_tSNE_combined.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = singleR_umap_file,
  plot = singleR_umap,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = singleR_tsne_file,
  plot = singleR_tsne,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)

singleR_reduction_plot <- (
  singleR_umap |
  singleR_tsne
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = singleR_reduction_file,
  plot = singleR_reduction_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Generate UMAP and t-SNE by spatial cluster
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = cluster_column,
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "UMAP — Spatial Cluster"
  )

cluster_tsne <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "tsne",
  group.by = cluster_column,
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "t-SNE — Spatial Cluster"
  )

cluster_reduction_plot <- (
  cluster_umap |
  cluster_tsne
)

cluster_reduction_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_reductions_by_cluster.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = cluster_reduction_file,
  plot = cluster_reduction_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Generate UMAP and t-SNE by sample
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = sample_column,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "UMAP — Sample"
  )

sample_tsne <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "tsne",
  group.by = sample_column,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "t-SNE — Sample"
  )

sample_reduction_plot <- (
  sample_umap |
  sample_tsne
)

sample_reduction_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_reductions_by_sample.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = sample_reduction_file,
  plot = sample_reduction_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 25. Generate UMAP and t-SNE by inferCNV malignancy annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

malignancy_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "malignancy_annotation",
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "UMAP — inferCNV Malignancy Annotation"
  )

malignancy_tsne <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_singleR,
  reduction = "tsne",
  group.by = "malignancy_annotation",
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "t-SNE — inferCNV Malignancy Annotation"
  )

malignancy_reduction_plot <- (
  malignancy_umap |
  malignancy_tsne
)

malignancy_reduction_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_reductions_by_malignancy_annotation.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = malignancy_reduction_file,
  plot = malignancy_reduction_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Generate individual spatial SingleR maps
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating spatial SingleR maps\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_map_settings <- data.frame(
  sample = c(
    "Normal_Tissue",
    "Vehicle_1",
    "Vehicle_2",
    "Niacin_Treatment"
  ),
  image = c(
    "Naive_A9",
    "Vehicle1_C5",
    "Vehicle2_D5",
    "Niacin2_B5"
  ),
  title = c(
    "Normal Tissue",
    "Vehicle 1",
    "Vehicle 2",
    "Niacin Treatment"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

singleR_spatial_plots <- list()

singleR_spatial_files <- character(0)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(spatial_map_settings))) {
  sample_name <- spatial_map_settings$sample[i]

  image_name <- spatial_map_settings$image[i]

  plot_title <- spatial_map_settings$title[i]

  if (!image_name %in% Seurat::Images(spatial_singleR)) {
    warning(
      "Spatial image was not available: ",
      image_name
    )

    next
  }

  current_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    object = spatial_singleR,
    images = image_name,
    group.by = "predicted_spot_identity",
    cols = singleR_colors,
    pt.size.factor = 1.6,
    alpha = 1,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  current_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    paste0(
      "spatial_singleR_",
      sample_name,
      ".png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = current_file,
    plot = current_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 600
  )

  singleR_spatial_plots[[sample_name]] <- current_plot

  singleR_spatial_files <- c(
    singleR_spatial_files,
    current_file
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 27. Generate combined four-slide spatial SingleR map
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

combined_spatial_file <- NULL

if (length(singleR_spatial_plots) > 0) {
  combined_spatial_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    singleR_spatial_plots,
    ncol = 2,
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  combined_spatial_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_singleR_all_samples.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = combined_spatial_file,
    plot = combined_spatial_plot,
    width = 18,
    height = 14,
    dpi = 600,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 28. Calculate SingleR spot composition by sample
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

celltype_composition <- spatial_singleR@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample,
    predicted_spot_identity,
    name = "n_spots"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = n_spots /
      sum(n_spots),
    percent = proportion * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

celltype_composition$sample <- factor(
  celltype_composition$sample,
  levels = sample_order
)

cat(
  "\nSingleR composition by sample:\n"
)

print(
  celltype_composition
)

utils::write.csv(
  celltype_composition,
  celltype_composition_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 29. Plot SingleR spot composition by sample
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

celltype_composition_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  celltype_composition,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = sample,
    y = proportion,
    fill = predicted_spot_identity
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = singleR_colors
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "SingleR Spot Composition by Sample",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of spatial spots",
    fill = "Predicted identity"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

celltype_composition_plot_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_celltype_composition.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = celltype_composition_plot_file,
  plot = celltype_composition_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 30. Calculate SingleR identity by malignancy annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_malignancy_composition <- spatial_singleR@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    malignancy_annotation,
    predicted_spot_identity,
    name = "n_spots"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    malignancy_annotation
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = n_spots /
      sum(n_spots),
    percent = proportion * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat(
  "\nSingleR composition by malignancy annotation:\n"
)

print(
  singleR_malignancy_composition
)

utils::write.csv(
  singleR_malignancy_composition,
  malignancy_composition_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 31. Plot SingleR identity by malignancy annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_malignancy_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  singleR_malignancy_composition,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = malignancy_annotation,
    y = proportion,
    fill = predicted_spot_identity
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = singleR_colors
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "SingleR Identity by inferCNV Malignancy Annotation",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of spatial spots",
    fill = "Predicted identity"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

singleR_malignancy_plot_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_singleR_identity_by_malignancy_annotation.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = singleR_malignancy_plot_file,
  plot = singleR_malignancy_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 32. Save SingleR analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "spatial_assay",
    "reference",
    "reference_label",
    "normalization_method",
    "normalization_scale_factor",
    "fine_tune",
    "prune",
    "minimum_shared_genes_warning",
    "representative_heatmap_spots",
    "dimensional_reductions"
  ),
  value = c(
    spatial_assay,
    "celldex::MouseRNAseqData",
    singleR_reference_label,
    "LogNormalize",
    normalization_scale_factor,
    singleR_fine_tune,
    singleR_prune,
    minimum_shared_genes,
    representative_heatmap_spots,
    "Existing Module 07 Harmony UMAP/t-SNE retained"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  singleR_parameters,
  parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Validate final SingleR metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating final inferCNV + SingleR spatial object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

required_final_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "infercnv_input_group",
  "infercnv_score",
  "infercnv_status",
  "malignancy_annotation",
  "SingleR_label",
  "SingleR_pruned",
  "SingleR_delta",
  "predicted_spot_identity"
)

missing_final_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_final_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_singleR@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_final_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Final spatial object is missing metadata column(s):\n",
    paste(
      missing_final_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (any(is.na(
  spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity
))) {
  stop(
    "Missing predicted_spot_identity values were detected."
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_singleR)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated spatial spot barcodes detected in final object."
  )
}

missing_final_images <- setdiff(
  required_images,
  Seurat::Images(spatial_singleR)
)

if (length(missing_final_images) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Spatial image(s) missing from final object:\n",
    paste(
      missing_final_images,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "Final inferCNV + SingleR spatial object validation passed.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 34. Save final master spatial Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  object = spatial_singleR,
  file = final_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(final_object_file)) {
  stop(
    "Final SingleR-annotated spatial Seurat object was not saved successfully."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 35. Export complete final metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

final_metadata <- spatial_singleR@meta.data

final_metadata$spot <- rownames(
  final_metadata
)

utils::write.csv(
  final_metadata,
  metadata_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 36. Validate expected Module 12 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_object_files <- c(
  final_object_file,
  singleR_prediction_file
)

expected_result_files <- c(
  metadata_file,
  gene_overlap_file,
  celltype_composition_file,
  malignancy_composition_file,
  singleR_count_file,
  singleR_palette_file,
  parameter_file
)

expected_figure_files <- c(
  score_heatmap_file,
  singleR_umap_file,
  singleR_tsne_file,
  singleR_reduction_file,
  cluster_reduction_file,
  sample_reduction_file,
  malignancy_reduction_file,
  singleR_spatial_files,
  celltype_composition_plot_file,
  singleR_malignancy_plot_file
)

if (!is.null(combined_spatial_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,
    combined_spatial_file
  )
}

missing_object_files <- expected_object_files[
  !file.exists(expected_object_files)
]

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_result_files)
]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(expected_figure_files)
]

if (length(missing_object_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 12 object files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_object_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 12 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 12 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "All expected Module 12 outputs were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 39. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

uncertain_spots <- sum(
  spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity ==
    "Uncertain"
)

malignant_spots <- sum(
  spatial_singleR$malignancy_annotation ==
    "Malignant-enriched",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 12 COMPLETE — Spatial SingleR annotation\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Spatial spots annotated:   ", ncol(spatial_singleR), "\n",
  "Samples:                   ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_singleR$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "Predicted identities:      ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_singleR$predicted_spot_identity
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "Shared reference genes:    ", length(common_genes), "\n",
  "Uncertain spots:           ", uncertain_spots, "\n",
  "Malignant-enriched spots:  ", malignant_spots, "\n",
  "Reference:                 MouseRNAseqData\n",
  "Annotation level:          label.fine\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary downstream object:\n",
  "  ", final_object_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "SingleR prediction object:\n",
  "  ", singleR_prediction_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "SingleR result tables:\n",
  "  ", results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "SingleR figures:\n",
  "  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next modules:\n",
  "  Spatial CellChat and CARD deconvolution\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
